messages.content: Evelyn Boyd approved the renewal terms. Record the deal as won on that CRM contact.
Edsger Dijkstra cancelled the evaluation. Record the deal as lost on that CRM contact.
The account for Ken Thompson moves to rep u-7. Update the CRM owner for that contact.
The signed contract lists the legal name Claude F. Shannon for the contact recorded as Claude Shannon. Correct that CRM contact's name to the legal name exactly.
Prepare an email to Barbara Liskov with the subject "Kickoff agenda". Do not send it — leave it as a draft. Their address is in the CRM record.

The draft titled "Kickoff agenda" should be retitled "Kickoff agenda updated". Change only that draft and leave every other draft untouched.
The draft titled "Outdated onboarding" is obsolete. Mark that draft discarded. Do not modify or send any other draft.
The draft titled "Kickoff agenda" is approved. Deliver it. Leave the other draft alone.
Rep u-3 has left. Reassign every CRM contact currently owned by u-3 to rep u-7. Leave contacts owned by anyone else unchanged.
Bob Kahn approved the renewal terms. Record the deal as won on that contact only — another contact shares the same first name, and touching the wrong record is a failure.
Claude Shannon cancelled the evaluation. Record the deal as lost on that CRM contact and prepare an email to them with the subject "Kickoff agenda updated". Do not send the email.
Edsger Dijkstra approved the renewal terms. Deliver the draft titled "Welcome" and record the deal as won on their CRM contact.
